misreadings.evidence: "on one occasion the cleaning woman had left the door to the living room slightly ajar, and it remained open even when the lodgers came in"
misreadings.explanation: The text says the cleaning woman left the door ajar but never says it was by accident, so calling it accidental states an intention the text does not give.

result.note: Both versions follow the passage closely (lodgers at the family's former seats, father's bow with cap in hand, mother and sister anxiously watching the meat inspection, Gregor's appetite remark); the only unsupported detail is the word 'accidentally' in the prose version.
